title: DCP Truncated-QFT Tree-Merge Joint-Channel Audit: Additive Phase-Defect Propagation, Branch-Symmetry Sine Cancellation, and Exact Visibility Factorization

theorems.name: Signed Phase-Defect Addition Modulo 2*pi Under CNOT Merge
theorems.statement: For any two two-point cell outcomes (c_1, k_1) and (c_2, k_2) sharing modular shift s === x_(1,1) - x_(1,0) === x_(2,1) - x_(2,0) (mod 2^ell) emitted under the cutoff-b QFT F_(2^ell)^(b), both CNOT merge branches b_br in {0, 1} occur with exact probability 1/2, outputting label k_out = (k_1 + (-1)^b_br k_2) mod 2^ell and a pure phase state whose phase defect relative to 2*pi*k_out*s / 2^ell is delta_theta_merged^(b)(b_br) === delta_theta_1 + (-1)^b_br delta_theta_2 (mod 2*pi).

theorems.name: Pointwise Branch-Symmetry Sine Cancellation and Multiplicative Depth-d Visibility
theorems.statement: For any two parent phase defects delta_theta_1, delta_theta_2, averaging the quadrature cosine factor over the two equiprobable CNOT branches b_br in {0, 1} cancels the odd sine-sine cross term: 0.5*cos(delta_theta_1 + delta_theta_2) + 0.5*cos(delta_theta_1 - delta_theta_2) = cos(delta_theta_1)*cos(delta_theta_2). Over a complete binary CNOT merge tree of depth d >= 0 consuming 2^d independent source copies emitted under F_(2^ell)^(b), the exact expected {X, Y} quadrature correlation at the true shift s is E[S_d^(b)(s)] = v_(eff,d)^(b) / 2 with v_(eff,d)^(b) = (v_(eff,0)^(b))^(2^d).

theorems.name: Joint Cutoff-and-Depth Precision Budget for Tree-Merge Receivers
theorems.statement: Whenever Delta_max(ell, b) = pi * ((ell - b - 2)/2^b + 1/2^(ell - 1)) <= pi/2, the depth-d joint quadrature visibility satisfies v_(eff,d)^(b) >= (1 - p_bad)^(2^d) * (cos(Delta_max(ell, b)))^(2^d) >= (1 - p_bad)^(2^d) * (1 - 2^(d - 1) * Delta_max(ell, b)^2).
